summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. In rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test, reference as subject); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when a stored term URI equals ref under node-type-aware equality (inherited by _RDFNamespace); _ipython_key_completions_ now returns dir(self.uri). In test/test_namespace.py: added NamespaceMembershipTest covering prefix positive/negative/self cases, SH, RDFS positive/negative, non-URIRef negatives, RDF positive, and RDF._1 expected False; added imports for RDF, RDFS, SH, Namespace, Literal. Tests and doctests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing committed. NamespaceManager membership was skipped (optional).
